report.name: FINREP F18.00 — Non-performing Exposures
report.description: Quarterly non-performing exposure (NPE) disclosure. Exposures are staged in SQL, classified as performing / non-performing in a Python engine under the EBA definition, then aggregated to segment level and published to the F18.00 template.

table.caption: F18.00 — Non-performing exposures by segment (reporting period 2026-Q3)

cdes.definition: Gross carrying amount of exposures classified as non-performing under the EBA definition (90+ days past due, or forborne unlikely-to-pay).

candidates.why: Final regulatory output; column and report mapping match the F18.00 cell.
Segment aggregation one hop upstream; same column name, pre-publication grain.
Account-level flagged exposure produced in Python; the NPE rule is opaque to the static parser.

cdes.expected_story: npl_exposure_eur = SUM(exposure × is_npl). The is_npl flag is computed in a Python engine (90+ dpd OR forborne), so the field trace stops at the Python boundary until the AI layer recovers the classification rule.

cdes.definition: Accumulated provisions held against the non-performing book divided by non-performing exposures.

candidates.why: Ratio computed in the segment mart; report multiplies by 100.

cdes.expected_story: npl_coverage_ratio = SUM(provision) / SUM(npl_exposure). A ratio of two aggregated figures.

cdes.definition: Non-performing exposures as a percentage of total gross carrying amount for the segment.

candidates.why: Computed in the report layer from NPE and gross exposure; inherits the Python boundary on the NPE input.

cdes.expected_story: npl_ratio_pct = npl_exposure / gross_carrying_amount × 100. The NPE numerator inherits the Python boundary from the classification step.

code.text:
-- Core banking: loan master (system of record)
CREATE TABLE raw.loan_accounts (
  loan_id                   VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,
  gross_carrying_amount_eur DECIMAL(18,2),
  days_past_due             INTEGER,
  forbearance_flag          SMALLINT,
  segment_code              VARCHAR
);

-- Collections / arrears system
CREATE TABLE raw.arrears (
  loan_id         VARCHAR,
  max_dpd_current INTEGER,
  cure_flag       SMALLINT,
  forborne_flag   SMALLINT
);

-- 01_stage_exposure.sql  ·  consolidated exposure book
CREATE TABLE stg.exposure_book AS
SELECT
    a.loan_id,
    a.gross_carrying_amount_eur,
    GREATEST(a.days_past_due, r.max_dpd_current) AS days_past_due,
    CASE WHEN a.forbearance_flag = 1 OR r.forborne_flag = 1
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                       AS forbearance_flag,
    a.segment_code                               AS segment,
    p.accumulated_provision_eur
FROM raw.loan_accounts a
LEFT JOIN raw.provisions p ON a.loan_id = p.loan_id
LEFT JOIN raw.arrears    r ON a.loan_id = r.loan_id;

# 02_npl_classify.py  ·  EBA non-performing exposure classification
import pandas as pd

book = pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM stg.exposure_book", conn)

def classify(row):
    # EBA NPE: 90+ days past due, OR forborne unlikely-to-pay
    dpd_default  = row.days_past_due >= 90
    forborne_utp = row.forbearance_flag == 1 and row.days_past_due >= 30
    return 1 if (dpd_default or forborne_utp) else 0

book["is_npl"]           = book.apply(classify, axis=1)
book["npl_exposure_eur"] = book.gross_carrying_amount_eur * book.is_npl
book["provision_eur"]    = book.accumulated_provision_eur

npl_flagged = book[["loan_id", "segment", "gross_carrying_amount_eur",
                    "is_npl", "npl_exposure_eur", "provision_eur"]]
npl_flagged.to_sql("npl_flagged", conn, if_exists="replace", index=False)

-- 03_npl_mart.sql  ·  aggregate NPE to portfolio segment
CREATE TABLE npl_by_segment AS
SELECT
    b.segment,
    SUM(b.gross_carrying_amount_eur)             AS gross_carrying_amount_eur,
    SUM(f.npl_exposure_eur)                      AS npl_exposure_eur,
    SUM(f.provision_eur)                         AS npl_provision_eur,
    SUM(f.provision_eur)
      / NULLIF(SUM(f.npl_exposure_eur), 0)       AS npl_coverage_ratio
FROM stg.exposure_book b
JOIN npl_flagged f ON b.loan_id = f.loan_id
GROUP BY b.segment;

-- 04_finrep_f1800_report.sql  ·  FINREP F18.00 template
CREATE TABLE finrep_f1800_npl AS
SELECT
    segment                                   AS report_row,
    gross_carrying_amount_eur,
    npl_exposure_eur,
    ROUND(npl_exposure_eur
      / NULLIF(gross_carrying_amount_eur, 0) * 100, 2) AS npl_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(npl_coverage_ratio * 100, 2)        AS npl_coverage_ratio_pct
FROM npl_by_segment;

tableEdges.reason: The non-performing flag (is_npl) is computed in a Python engine under the EBA definition (90+ days past due OR forborne unlikely-to-pay). npl_exposure_eur = exposure × is_npl is produced row-by-row in pandas, so the per-account classification rule is opaque to the static parser — this is where AI + a manual review of the run logs and model catalogue recover the rule.
